title: Spirit of Glory
definition: Spirit of Glory is a biblical title highlighting the Holy Spirit's presence with believers, especially in suffering for Christ.
summary: The Spirit of glory rests upon those who suffer for Christ.
christFocus: Jesus was glorified through suffering, and the Spirit strengthens His people to endure with hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit of glory is mentioned in the context of suffering for Christ. Believers who are insulted or persecuted are not abandoned; the Spirit of glory rests upon them.

The Spirit gives endurance, hope, worship, and a foretaste of the glory that will be revealed. He strengthens believers to suffer without shame.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Suffering for Christ can make believers feel ashamed or alone. This doctrine matters because God's presence rests on His people in costly faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not be ashamed of suffering for Christ. Ask the Spirit to strengthen you, make Christ glorious to you, and keep you faithful.
